name: put the answer in the part nobody searches
one_line: The thing to be found is put in the title or the instruction line, whole and in plain sight, where reading has already passed once.
how: Take a sheet that asks for something and put the answer in the part that is read on the way to the task and never read again: the title, the instruction line, the frame round the edge. Declare that it is there, say how long it is, say it is not reversed and not coded — and do not say where. Nothing is hidden and no letter is disturbed inside any word; what hides it is that the reader is busy. Then add the second question, why did you not see it, and mean it, because without that the sheet is a joke at somebody's expense and with it the answer is that their attention was on the task. Use it once per person and no more.

knobs.effect: the title and the instruction line are read once and never revisited, so they work; inside the field it is an ordinary search and hides nothing; outside the printed area it is not there at all and the sheet is lying.

declared, with a length given, it is a fair question and failing to find it is the interesting part; undeclared, nobody looks and nothing happens, which is the difference between a form and an anecdote told afterwards.

knobs.knob: whether the second question is asked
knobs.effect: asked, whoever did not find it has something to think about and nothing to feel bad about; left out, the sheet says only that they missed something obvious, and that is the whole of what it says.

once per person is the entire budget. A second sheet of the same kind meets somebody who reads the title first, and that does not weaken the move — it removes it, leaving a sheet with nothing else on it.

where_the_work_is: In the declaration. Saying that something is there and how long it is turns a trick into a question that can be answered, and it is also what makes the failure worth talking about afterwards instead of worth covering up.
breaks: One use per person, with no way to know who has already spent theirs, so it cannot go into anything meant to be reused. It produces nothing that comes back: the sheet returns what it was already returning, with one blank filled or not. On a display the title is the first line and is read the same way, so the move survives — but 800×480 in one bit is small enough to be taken in at a glance, which spends the single use at once.
